title: Expedition 33 Endings Explained - All Endings Guide
description: All endings in Expedition 33 explained with how to unlock each one, Maelle's critical choice between truth and lie, ending analysis, and New Game+ details.

sections.title: Story Summary
sections.content:
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 tells the story of Gustave leading a team of warriors to confront The Paintress — a mysterious entity who annually erases all people of a specific age through her magical canvas. Each year she paints a number, and everyone of that age vanishes during the Gommage ceremony.

The expedition travels across The Continent, gathering allies and uncovering the truth about The Paintress, the nature of reality, and the cyclical destruction that has plagued their world. Along the way, the party discovers that the relationship between humanity and The Paintress is far more complex than simple antagonism.

Key Story Themes

  • Mortality and acceptance: Characters face the inevitability of erasure and choose how to respond
  • Truth vs. comfortable lies: The expedition uncovers revelations that challenge everything they believed
  • Free will vs. determinism: Are the expeditions truly free to choose, or are they part of The Paintress's design?
  • Legacy and sacrifice: What does it mean to fight for a future you may never see?

The story culminates in a confrontation at The Monolith where your choices — particularly one critical decision involving Maelle — determine which ending you receive.

sections.title: How Endings Work
sections.content:
Expedition 33 features multiple endings determined primarily by one key choice made during Act 3, combined with your relationship levels with party members. The game does not use a branching path system throughout — instead, it funnels toward a critical decision point.

Ending Requirements

  • Relationship levels: Build relationships with party members through camp conversations and optional interactions throughout Acts 1-3
  • Maelle's choice: A pivotal dialogue with Maelle in Act 3 where you choose between telling the truth or lying
  • Story completion: All endings require defeating the final boss

When Does the Choice Happen?

The critical branching point occurs during Act 3's relationship interaction with Maelle. This is one of the game's missable moments — if you skip this conversation, you are locked into a specific ending path.

Can You See All Endings?

You cannot see all endings in a single playthrough. After beating the final boss, your save returns to the last Expedition Flag, but the ending choice is already locked. To see alternate endings, you must start New Game+ or replay from an earlier autosave slot (the game rotates through 21 autosaves).

sections.title: All Endings & How to Get Them
sections.content:
Expedition 33 has three primary endings based on your choices and relationship progress. Each offers a different resolution to the conflict with The Paintress.

Ending 1: Breaking the Cycle (True Ending)

The party confronts The Paintress with full knowledge of the truth. By accepting the reality of their situation and choosing to fight not out of hatred but understanding, they break the eternal cycle of Gommage. The world is freed from annual erasure.

Requirements: Tell Maelle the truth during the Act 3 conversation. Maintain high relationships with core party members. Defeat the final boss.

Ending 2: The Cycle Continues

Gustave and the party defeat The Paintress through force alone, without truly understanding the nature of the cycle. While the immediate threat is eliminated, the underlying mechanism remains. A new Paintress will eventually emerge to continue the Gommage.

Requirements: Lie to Maelle during Act 3, or miss the conversation entirely. Standard final boss defeat.

Ending 3: Sacrifice Ending

A bittersweet conclusion where the cycle is broken but at great personal cost. One party member offers themselves as a replacement for The Paintress's role, ensuring the world's continued existence while shouldering the burden alone.

Requirements: Tell Maelle the truth AND have maximum relationship with the relevant party member. Specific dialogue choices during the final confrontation.

sections.title: Maelle's Critical Choice (Truth vs Lie)
sections.content:
The most important decision in Expedition 33 occurs during a private conversation with Maelle in Act 3. The party has discovered a devastating truth about The Paintress and the nature of their world. Maelle directly asks you what you've learned.

The Truth Option

Telling Maelle the truth means sharing everything the expedition has discovered — including uncomfortable revelations about the cycle, The Paintress's origins, and what breaking the cycle truly requires. This leads toward Endings 1 or 3.

Consequences:

  • Maelle accepts the truth and becomes resolved to fight with full understanding
  • Opens the possibility of the True Ending or Sacrifice Ending
  • Changes final boss dialogue and cutscenes
  • Maelle's combat abilities may be enhanced for the final fight

The Lie Option

Lying to protect Maelle means keeping the truth hidden, allowing her to fight The Paintress based on incomplete information. This is presented as a compassionate choice — shielding someone you care about from painful knowledge.

Consequences:

  • Maelle fights with determination but without full understanding
  • Locks you into Ending 2 (The Cycle Continues)
  • Different final boss dialogue reflecting incomplete knowledge
  • The relationship with Maelle is preserved but built on deception

Missing the Conversation

If you skip or miss this interaction entirely, the game defaults to the Lie path. This is why it's flagged as missable content — actively seek out the Maelle conversation during Act 3.

sections.title: Ending Analysis
sections.content:
Each ending offers a thematically coherent resolution that reflects the player's approach to the game's central conflict.

Ending 1 Analysis: Truth and Liberation

The True Ending argues that genuine freedom requires confronting uncomfortable truths. By sharing knowledge with Maelle and fighting with full understanding, the expedition transcends the cycle rather than merely defeating its current manifestation. This parallels the game's real-time combat system — you succeed not by brute force but by understanding enemy patterns.

Ending 2 Analysis: Perpetual Conflict

The Cycle Continues ending is not necessarily a "bad" ending. It reflects a realistic outcome — sometimes people choose comfortable lies over painful truths, and sometimes defeating an immediate threat doesn't solve the underlying problem. The world is saved temporarily, but the fundamental issue remains.

Ending 3 Analysis: Meaningful Sacrifice

The Sacrifice Ending presents the most emotionally complex resolution. Someone chooses to take The Paintress's place — not to continue the cycle of destruction, but to maintain the world's existence through a benevolent form of the role. It asks whether breaking a cycle always requires someone to bear its weight.

Developer Intent

Sandfall Interactive designed Expedition 33 as a complete experience with no planned expansions or DLC. Each ending is considered valid — there is no "true" canonical ending. The studio has stated they prefer games with clear creative boundaries rather than indefinite continuation.

sections.title: New Game+
sections.content:
New Game+ becomes available after completing the story and allows you to replay with carried-over progression — but comes with important caveats.

What Carries Over

  • Party levels and attribute distribution
  • Weapon upgrade levels
  • Unlocked abilities and skill slots
  • Lumina effects

What Resets

  • All collectibles (Journals, Records, Lost Gestrals, Tints)
  • Story progression and all quest flags
  • Relationship levels with party members
  • All missable items and interactions reset (can re-obtain them)

Critical Warning

Starting New Game+ permanently erases your previous save. There is no way to maintain both a completed save and a NG+ run simultaneously. Complete all cleanup, collectibles, and the Endless Tower before starting NG+.

Is NG+ Required?

New Game+ is not required for any trophy or achievement. If you missed collectibles in your first playthrough, you must recollect all of them again in NG+ since trackers reset. The primary reasons to play NG+ are:

  • Experiencing alternate endings with different choices
  • Reaching Level 99 (grinding is possible without NG+ but slower)
  • Replaying the story with full power — trivializing early bosses with endgame builds
  • Correcting missed collectibles if your first playthrough was incomplete
